name: Chez Panisse
basis: A fixed menu that changes daily with the season, cooked from ingredients bought directly from a long-standing network of local farmers, ranchers and dairies. Founder Alice Waters started the farm-to-table movement here in 1971.

sources.title: Alice Waters: 40 Years Of Sustainable Food (NPR)
The legacy of Alice Waters and farm-to-table dining 50 years later (FSR Magazine)

name: Blue Hill
basis: Dan Barber's original restaurant cooks with produce, meat and grains from the Stone Barns farm and other Hudson Valley farms.

name: Le Pigeon
basis: Gabriel Rucker's nose-to-tail French bistro serves seasonal tasting menus cooked in house; the menu 'evolves with the seasons'.

sources.title: Le Pigeon: Leading the West Coast, Nose-To-Tail Charge (Food GPS)

name: Ava Gene's
basis: An 'aggressively seasonal' Roman-inspired menu built on produce and meat from Pacific Northwest farmers and ranchers; pasta is milled, extruded and rolled in house.

name: Screen Door
basis: Southern comfort food made with local, fresh, organic produce and poultry; chicken is battered and fried in house and biscuits are baked fresh.

sources.title: Screen Door Bringing Southern Dining Up North (The Daily Meal)
Screen Door Eastside (restaurant's own description on OpenTable)
Best fried chicken and waffles (Portland Monthly)

name: Husk
basis: 'If it doesn't come from the South, it's not coming through the door': every ingredient is Southern, and a chalkboard lists the farms and purveyors used that day.

sources.title: This South Carolina Restaurant Has Some Pretty Strict Rules About The Ingredients It Uses (Chowhound)
Chef Sean Brock on breeding pigs and celebrating Southern food (Nation's Restaurant News)

name: Franklin Barbecue
basis: Whole briskets are seasoned with salt and pepper and smoked for 14+ hours over post oak in the smokehouse behind the restaurant. We found nothing on how the sides are made.

sources.title: What To Eat In Austin: Brisket (The Daily Meal)

name: Zuni Café
basis: Slow-cooked, locally sourced food from a wood-fired brick oven; chickens are dry-brined for days in house, and the menu changes with what local farms are growing.
